changed.what: Applied U30b's request: step 10 carries N13-30's per-chart stage-3 inertia leg (N10a-13's planted one-link set, --keep-prior actuators/contact, verb run with the recorded chart and conformance runs per chart, zero infeasible iterates for affine-invariant and log-cholesky, recovery errors with units, euclidean-projected without the feature), with acceptance, log lines and the 𝖯 + V control; KA-725 attributed to ground_clock.sh; logged thresholds made consistent with the 0.70 ratio; N10a-13, N13-30 related.

Field names aligned with the card schema BD-069 (j_rotor, kt/ke, not rotor_inertia); the covariance block written as N15ax-03 specifies it (paths sorted ascending, lower triangle, diagonal = σ², unc normal; delay_set with its interval); stribeck_shape never changed by the writer (v_s fitted under one shape means another speed under the other), with a control; layering: the sampler is reached by frob-learn (layer 4) through a CorrelatedDraw trait in frob-actuate, never by naming frob-ground (layer 5).

ground::effective was specified as what the randomization compiler (frob-learn, layer 4) and sensitivity analysis (frob-analyze, layer 4) must call, but frob-ground is layer 5 and xtask check-layers refuses upward dependencies: added the CardWidthSource trait in frob-actuate (effective + sampler), CardOwnWidths (fail closed on measured fields) and GroundWidths injected by frob-verbs, with acceptance and five tests.

'the model-form term of the prior card's class' (display rule before validation) was undefined: defined (DESIGN) from the latest ground.floor of an admitted version of the lineage or class; the floor event gains sigma_mf2_se and per-channel rows, which Considerations already promised; the e2e fixture named as the instrumented cart's planted contact-dissipation difference (the script's real data) with σ_mf > 0 asserted.

k = 1 update used an undefined σ_prior,mean and kept the prior mean while k ≥ 2 dropped it without saying so: μ₀ and σ_prior,mean defined (measured class card or generic value), class_mean_sd at k = 1 given, the k ≥ 2 choice stated as DESIGN; worked k = 1 case (1.0818, 0.013295, 0.1892) added to acceptance and tests.

Considerations stated the tolerance rule as 'at least twice the instrument sigma, at most the margin' but step 4 had no upper check: a tolerance wider than the decision margin is now registered unresolvable, with a test (margin 0.05 s, σ 0.01 s: 0.04 resolvable, 0.06 not).

N30a-29 delegates its e2e to this script, but step 7 only checked that the floor event exists: now logs σ_mf per channel with rows and standard error and posterior/floor/reported σ per field, asserts reported ≥ both and σ_mf > 0 on the cart fixture's planted model-form difference.

The calibration set was keyed by model lineage, but pools are keyed by cell, ModelId and origin (N30a-07) and the plan refuses pooling across ModelIds; band artifact now records the ModelId beside its lineage.

Check 4 refused a ModelId 'not in the lineage', yet a later card version stays in its lineage (N30a-34), so the acceptance case (one card version later is refused) could not hold: the check now compares the pool's ModelId. Step 1 listed two per-unit statistics while step 7 makes keyed-pick the default of three: aligned.
BD-351 (experiment.suggest) moved to related: the planner rows it served went to the drift script N30a-44 when N30b-34 was folded; this script never calls it.

Applied U30b's request (checked against §30.23 and N30b-27): registries/ground/expiry.toml defined (policy_version, on_part_replacement = always, a [default] row 90 days / 200 hours with source, [[class]] rows keyed by actuator and transmission class with a source); 0 or absent limits refused, a sourceless row rejected and the default applied; the smallest limit over the bound classes applies; limits and policy_version stored in the calibration record at issue, effective limit = min(at issue, now); acceptance and expiry_registry.rs tests. Also: 'expires at 60' made 'limit 60, retired at 61 days' to match its own tests, and the e2e line counts the nine scope changes battery C plants, not seven.

Applied U30b's request with corrected figures: drift::miss_power(e_now, p, horizon 20) by exact first-passage recursion, printed from a fresh start and from the current e-value. The requested '0.58, 0.86, 0.98 after ten covered episodes' are the clean-phase expectation over Binomial(10, q), q ~ Beta(2, 19) (0.586, 0.863, 0.983); ten straight covers give 0.427, 0.779, 0.969; both are now stated and labelled, with three tests.

The --status listing now prints the miss monitor's power from a fresh start and from the current e-value (N30a-42's miss_power) and the expiry limits with their source and the policy_version stored at issue (N30a-40's new registry); acceptance figures added.

Applied U30b's request: R-10's registered post-drift miss probability raised from 0.7 to 0.8 as BD-388 now registers; the power argument corrected (fresh-start 0.70/0.92/0.99 does not apply after ten clean episodes; clean-phase expectation 0.586/0.863/0.983, ten straight covers 0.427/0.779/0.969), so 0.7 would fail the 90% clause for power; per-resample e-value at the change and its computed power logged beside the measured fraction; expiry step prints the limits' source and policy_version.

The calibration test required each normalized pose error's variance within 10% of 1 over 10³ draws: that is 2.2 standard errors, so a correct covariance fails one of six components on about 14% of seeds. Now: mean squared Mahalanobis distance within 10% of 6 (5.5 SE) and per-component variance within 0.15 of 1 (3.4 SE).

Thickness = nominal + d_outer − d_inner with step 2's per-face outward deviations doubles a translation along the normal instead of cancelling it, contradicting the stated first-order pose cancellation: both deviations now taken along the outer normal (equivalently nominal + d_outer + d_inner with per-face normals), stated as DESIGN, with test thickness_sign_convention.

Step 1 planted a 10°-about-z pose, six fiducials and a 3 mm wall while the folded step 11 said R-13's values (four fiducials, 2° about (1,2,2)/3, (3.0, −1.5, 0.8) mm, 2.5 mm wall) replace them: step 1 now states R-13's values, and the two-bore geometry joins the registered extensions.

The rig.trials rule (attempted equals the operator counter and the episode-row count, or admission is refused) had no acceptance item or test: added, with the payload naming the two numbers that differ.

Step guess-share asserted the old cards: grammar without the synthetic column that BD-139 now prints (k = a + b + f, one decimal): the line is parsed with the full grammar and synthetic=0 asserted; artifact surfaces registered at M5 (.fbuild, the kit) are exported through their registered examples, so the script needs no edit when they register.

The verb feeds the reality-gap variance event of N30a-09 (named in Scope and step 8) without depending on it: N30a-09 added to deps, with a test; the interval-score worked case now states its interval [4.05, 4.42] s and 2/α = 20, without which 1.97 and 1.37 could not be checked.

The DC-07 automaton and fallback triggers had no edge for expiry, the fourth retirement trigger of §30.13 (N30a-40), although the record cites the expiry policy_version: a cell retired by age would still read calibrated-exchangeable in the core. Expiry added as DESIGN (the plan's DC-07 list names the other three), with acceptance and fallback_on_expiry.
The kill decision N30b-21 rejects a receipt by the store's object count at start, which the receipt did not record: the receipt now records it and whether the network was disabled.
'Beads that exist only on the surviving branch of identification are closed' said the opposite of what it meant under the fired kill: now the branch the kill removes (identification by fitting).

The decision rule read 'scope changes fired of seven' and 'seven of seven', but the drift gate's battery (N30a-44, battery C) plants and records nine (the seven manifest changes plus a card version and a kernel digest): rule, measurement and decision_table (eight of nine fails) aligned with the gate row.

The checklist claimed every item is an admission refusal and the test mapped 'each of the seven items' to codes, but the seventh (a compilable model) maps to no Ground refusal: it is now settled by compiling the model and recorded as the compiler's result.

The demo predicted and scored only the 10 held-out episodes, yet issued a band at n = 20, which needs 20 scored residuals (N30a-36): the 20 calibration episodes are now a frozen, scored validation prediction and the holdout is scored after the band; `ground.band --design/--task-family` replaced by BD-393's --cell form; the unbuilt-design refusal names 895; the line on reports follows BD-139 (calibrated [...] on the real lane, synthetic [...] on the CPU lane; the acceptance had said no-claim); the 'omitted-law episodes raise the exchangeability alarm' step, which at n = 20 is chance, made the deterministic envelope scope change then 897; BD-394 and N30b-06 added to deps; three tests.

Item 7 and test status_prints_power_facts label 0.58, 0.86, 0.98 as the power 'after ten covered episodes'; ten straight covers (E = 0.641¹⁰ = 0.0117) give 0.427, 0.779, 0.969 at 0.6, 0.7, 0.8.
